i18n.zhSummary: 虽然我看到“MCP 兼容”这个术语，但我无法解释它与 API 有何不同。在本文中，我们将根据截至 2026 年 10 月的最新信息，解释 MCP 的工作原理、它与 API 的区别以及在业务中使用它时的注意事项。MCP（模型上下文协议）是连接 AI 与外部工具和数据的通用标准。当供应商提出“让我们使用MCP将内部系统和AI连接起来”时，许多负责人不知所措。
i18n.enTitle: What is MCP? Easy-to-understand explanation of the mechanism that connects AI and business tools and the difference between APIs
i18n.enSummary: Although I see the term "MCP compatible", I can't explain how it differs from API. In this article, we will explain how MCP works, how it differs from API, and what to keep in mind when using it in business, based on the latest information as of October 2026. MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a common standard for connecting AI with external tools and data. When a vendor proposes, ``Let's link in-house systems and AI using MCP,'' many people in charge are at a loss as to whether to make a decision.
